newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea won ends down on import deals, short cover.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea won ends down on import deals, short cover.

text.p: The won closed lower versus the dollar on Tuesday after import settlements and dollar short-covering outweighed month-end export deals, dealers said.
The won stood at 818.70 at the closing bell against the opening and intra-day high of 818.00. It hit a low of 819.10.
"The dollar gained in early trading on import deals and rose further to an intra-day high in late trading on short dollar-covering by foreign banks," said Kim Young-chun of SEOULBANK.
Dealers said month-end export negotiations and tight won liquidity in money markets blocked the local currency from falling much further.
They forecast the won to consolidate in a range of 818 to 819.50 on Wednesday with the base mid-rate at around 818.80.
